input.title: The Smooth Skin Set — Stick, Mitt & Heel Stick
input.descriptionHtml:
The whole routine for smoother legs, arms and heels.

What's inside

  1. The Exfoliating Mitt: buffs away dead skin in the shower, 1–2 times a week.
  2. The Smooth Stick: glycolic acid swipe-on for rough, bumpy skin.
  3. The Heel Stick: urea + salicylic acid balm for rough heels and elbows.

Your routine

  • Shower: mitt on damp skin, light pressure, 1–2 times a week.
  • Evening: Smooth Stick on legs and arms.
  • Night: Heel Stick on heels and elbows only.

Not for broken or irritated skin. Patch test first. Use sunscreen on treated areas.

Shipping

Free US shipping. Orders ship in 1–3 business days and arrive in 7–12 business days, with tracking.

30-day smooth-skin guarantee

Use it for 30 days. If you don't love how your skin feels, email us for a full refund. Keep the product.
